_comment: Copy to frontend/public/checkout-config.json and fill in. It is fetched at
runtime by /checkout, NOT baked into the bundle, so changing a price id is a
Everything in this file is PUBLIC by design: a Paddle client token, a Paddle
price id and a Cloud Function URL are all safe in a page. The Razorpay key
SECRET is not here and must never be — the subscription is created by
functions/createSubscription, which is also the only place notes.uid can be
attached from a verified ID token.
If this file is absent, /checkout says 'not configured on this deployment
yet' and charges nothing. That is deliberate: an unconfigured checkout and a
declined card must never look the same to the person paying.
Add checkout-config.json to .gitignore if you would rather not commit ids.
